Advertisement for University Website
SHRI MATA VAISHNO DEVI UNIVERSITY
Kakryal, Katra – 182320 (J&K)
(Ranked 101st among Engineering Institutions, 16th in Architecture and in top 100 Business
Schools in the NIRF 2022 ranking of MHRD, GoI.)
Walk-in-interview for recruitment of Research Assistant (01 position) and Field
Investigator (01 position) under Research Project RP-138 at School of
Architecture & Landscape Design on 20th September 2022 at 10:30 a.m. and
12:15 p.m.
Type of project: Minor Action Research Project
Title of the project: An Evaluation of Spatial Plan Preparation Process for Rurban
Cluster in Jammu and Kashmir Region
Sponsored by: MGNCRE, Ministry of Education, Government of India
Interested and eligible candidates may appear for walk-in interview before the selection
committee for the position of Research Assistant and Field Investigator in funded
project purely on temporary & contractual basis for a period of 6 months for Research
Assistant and 2 months for Field Investigator (or co-terminus with project), on
20/09/2022 at 10:30 a.m. and 12:15 p.m.
Qualification for both the positions: Master’s degree in Architecture/ Planning/ Geography/
Business Administration/ Economics/ Commerce/ Technology from a recognized University/
Institute with 55% marks or equivalent CGPA.
Remuneration: Rs.16,000/- per month (fixed) for Research Assistant and Rs.15,000/- per
month (fixed) for Field Investigator.
No. of Position: 01 (One) for each position.
Maximum age on the date of interview: 40 years.
Interested candidates must send their detailed CV along with documentary proof at the email
id: sourovee.dutta@smvdu.ac.in before 16th September, 2022.
General terms and conditions
1. Only eligible candidates shall be allowed to appear in the interview. The decision of
the Selection Committee will be final in this regard.
2. Candidates appearing in the interview should bring the originals of degree certificates
(one set of photocopy) and date of birth proof along with any other relevant
information (e.g. experience certificates, copies of publications if any, awards,
recommendation letters etc.).
3. The above position is purely temporary and will terminate automatically without any
notice or compensation on termination of the research scheme and the research
student shall have no claim of appointment. An undertaking to the effect is required
to be given by the student at the time of joining, if selected.
4. The selected individual may be assigned to perform any other duties time to time
commensurate with his/ her qualifications. The project involves travelling in various
locations across the State of Jammu & Kashmir for the purpose of data collection.
5. No TA/ DA is admissible for attending the interview.
Sd/-
Ref: SMVDU/R&D/22/4069 Dr. Sourovee Dutta
Dated: 07/09/2022 Project Director (RP-138)
